description: This source file defines the CronJobsStore class, a singleton managing scheduled jobs, their execution logs, and related state within an application. It includes methods for starting/stopping periodic refreshes, handling external gateway events, and modifying cron jobs via remote gateway calls.

classes.name: CronJobsStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the list of cron jobs, their execution state, and interactions with a gateway service for scheduling and executing jobs. It includes asynchronous operations for refreshing job data, starting/stopping polling, and handling push events.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes polling and event subscriptions to keep cron job data synchronized with the external gateway.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels ongoing refresh and event-handling tasks.

methods.name: refreshJobs
methods.description: Fetches the current list of cron jobs and their status from the gateway.

methods.name: refreshRuns
methods.description: Fetches log entries for a specific cron job.

methods.name: runJob
methods.description: Triggers manual execution of a cron job, optionally forcing the run.

methods.name: removeJob
methods.description: Removes a cron job from the schedule.

methods.name: setJobEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific cron job.

methods.name: upsertJob
methods.description: Updates an existing cron job or adds a new one.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming gateway push events related to cron jobs.

methods.name: handle(cronEvent:)
methods.description: Handles specific cron-related events received from the gateway, possibly triggering refreshes.

methods.name: scheduleRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a delayed refresh of cron jobs following an external event.

methods.name: scheduleRunsRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a delayed refresh of cron run logs for a specific job.
